description: This file defines a REST API resource for managing documents attached to various entities in the system. It includes endpoints for listing, creating, updating, retrieving, downloading, and deleting documents, utilizing JAX-RS annotations and Swagger documentation.

classes.name: DocumentManagementApiResource
classes.description: A REST controller class providing endpoints to manage documents related to various entities within the application.

methods.name: retrieveAllDocuments
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list all documents attached to a specified entity.

methods.name: createDocument
methods.description: Handles POST requests to upload and create a new document for a specified entity, accepting multipart form data including the file.

methods.name: updateDocument
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to update an existing document, including optional file replacement.

methods.name: getDocument
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve metadata of a specific document.

methods.name: downloadFile
methods.description: Handles GET requests to download the binary file associated with a document.

methods.name: deleteDocument
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove a specified document.
